summary: Iteration 17 tested the match-result fix, new quiz categories, category logos, the players->trivia migration and the new /category screen. Backend: new file test_iter17_categories_results.py passed 22/22. Full regression with pytest -n 0 passed 304/304, so tournament and classic cumulative still work. Frontend E2E at 375x667 with a TEST admin session. /category renders 8 cards in the right order (all, liga, bali, trivia, garuda, persebaya, persib, persija) with the right labels. Tapping a card shows the check badge, and MULAI routes to /quiz?category=X. Empty persib/liga show 'Belum ada soal'. all/trivia/garuda load questions; the trivia photo question is shown. In /admin, a finished match with no score shows HASIL. The modal saves (3-1) and the label then changes to UBAH; correcting to 0-1 persisted. All 8 logo cells work: uploading a Persija logo through the file chooser showed it on the category card, and Hapus removed it. All 7 qi-tab chips are present, and adding a Persija question through the form worked. Found 1 HIGH bug: in a Classic game on a category with fewer than 10 questions, POST /scores returns 422 game_too_fast. No deprecated packages detected.

critical.issue: On a Classic game in a category with fewer than 10 questions, the score is rejected with 422 'game_too_fast'. Madura United/trivia currently has 1 question, and every new category starts empty or nearly empty. The frontend ends the game after queue.length questions but still sends total=CLASSIC_COUNT (10) (quiz.tsx:111). The backend then requires total*0.8 = 8s (server.py ~line 340). Reproduced in the UI: Persija had 1 question, answered at once -> result shows BENAR 1 / SALAH 9 / 10% and 'Gagal mengirim skor. Periksa koneksi kamu.' The rejected call also uses up the game ticket.

minor.issue: Content-type/size is not checked (any bytes are accepted). Old logo objects are never deleted from storage on replace or delete.

Only 1 of 38 players had a photo and was not deleted, so the migration created just 1 trivia item. This is correct for the data, but Madura United now has only 1 question. The 'last order_index' query also counts soft-deleted items.

ui_bugs.issue: In Classic with a pool smaller than 10, the header shows Q1/10 and the game ends after 1 question. The result counts the missing questions as wrong (SALAH 9, Akurasi 10%).

Opening UBAH pre-fills only the score. resScorerIds/resMotmId are not loaded from m.scorer_player_ids/motm_player_id, so correcting a score silently clears the scorers and MOTM and removes those bonus points from predictions on re-score.

integration_issues.flow: Classic quiz on a small category -> submit score
integration_issues.issue: Shown above: /scores 422 game_too_fast, and the error message wrongly blames the connection.

issues: The Madura United description is cut off ('Laskar Sape ...') on 375px.
The header (title + sparks) takes about 170px, so at 667px only about 5 cards are visible above the fixed CTA.
The 'Hapus' logo link is 30x11px (about 46x27 with hitSlop), below 44px, and deletes with no confirm.
Logo grid labels are cut off ('Semua Kate…', 'Persib Band…'); the 3-per-row grid leaves empty space on the right.
The HASIL/UBAH button is 32px tall (hitSlop 8 helps).
The header still says 'DATABASE PEMAIN' even though Tebak Pemain was removed.
The result modal has no visible close/cancel button.
back-to-category does router.replace('/category') without mode, so Time Attack users land on the Classic screen.

action_items: HIGH: Fix Classic on small categories. Either send total=min(CLASSIC_COUNT, queue.length) from quiz.tsx and show Q{i}/{min} in the header, or block starting Classic when the pool has fewer than 10 questions. Also make sure the backend game_too_fast check (total*0.8s) does not reject honest fast short games. Show the real reason instead of 'Periksa koneksi kamu' on 422.
MEDIUM: In admin.tsx, the set-result onPress should also pre-fill setResScorerIds(m.scorer_player_ids) and setResMotmId(m.motm_player_id) so a correction keeps the scorer/MOTM bonuses.
LOW: Empty-state back button should keep the mode param. Enlarge the 'Hapus' touch target and add a confirm. Rename the admin header. Add a close button to the result modal.
LOW: Validate logo image type/size and clean up old storage objects.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.tsx is 1917 lines and server.py is 2713 lines (>700). They should be split.
The /scores ticket is used up even when the request is rejected as game_too_fast, so the user cannot retry.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work; score submit fails on small categories)

seed_data_creation: TEST_it17_* / TEST_fe17_admin users and sessions, match mt_TEST_fe17, TEST quiz items and the persija logo were all created and then cleaned up. category_logos is now {}. tournament_enabled stays False. 'Tos Joki' was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FE auth: wait 3s, set localStorage 'cakmad.session_token', goto '/', wait 4s, then navigate. Use `python /app/backend/tests/seed_iter17_fe.py seed|state|cleanup` (TEST admin + finished match mt_TEST_fe17). Logo upload works in Playwright via page.expect_file_chooser on catlogo-pick-{k}. To reproduce the HIGH bug: add 1 question in persija, play Classic, answer immediately -> /scores 422 game_too_fast.
rca_of_issue: Small-category Classic: pickDynamicQuestions returns min(10, pool) items, so the quiz ends after pool.length questions. finish() still sends total=CLASSIC_COUNT=10 (quiz.tsx:111). Backend min_secs = total*0.8 = 8s, and a 1-question game takes about 2s -> 422 game_too_fast. Mitigation: send the real total, or require at least 10 questions for Classic.
